name: River Split
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #19 — two long trampoline banks with a narrow contested centre isle stranded between them over TWO voids (two 'rivers'), capped by two spring thrones over the gaps. The banks are safe farms; the small centre isle is a hot seat with a chasm on each side, and the two thrones pull players out over the water. 620px gaps, symmetric, no hazard.

GEOMETRY: LEFT BANK (trampoline x0..1500 top1080) / CENTRE isle (bubblegum x2120..2740 top1080) / RIGHT BANK (trampoline x3360..4860 top1080), two 620px void gaps (left x1500..2120, right x2740..3360). Two spring THRONES (left x1780..2120 top560, right x3020..3360 top560, both h48) hang 520px above the banks/centre, each offset over a gap. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -560..5420, ~560px side runway; bottom y1920 = 712px recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 620px gap in ~0.9s @ ~26 fuel; super 2800 clears all):
- GAP bank<->centre (two x 620px over void): each > 527 max spring drift and >> 395/320 drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both ways; miss = fall into a river. Verb: FLY.
- REACH the CENTRE isle: only by boosting over one of the two 620px gaps (no bounce route) — holding it is exposed with a chasm each side. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to a THRONE (top560): 520px above the banks (1080) AND offset over a gap. Trampoline apex 270 reaches y810 -> 270px short before the offset; under-shot drops into a river. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: bank/centre bottom (1192-1208) to bottom blast (1920) = ~712px recovery sky (>= 650); the small centre isle gives little runway (hot seat). Verb: FLY.
- Both gaps exceed a spring bounce's reach and the thrones sit above spring apex, so flight is required. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
